# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest 1.x version gets security fixes. If you're on an older version, please update first.

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 1.x (latest) | yes |
| 0.x | no |

## Reporting a problem

Please don't open a public issue for a security problem.

Report it privately here: [new security advisory](https://github.com/AhmedAbdoElhawary/image_picker_plus/security/advisories/new).

Tell me:

- which version you use, and on which platform
- what the problem is and what someone could do with it
- steps to reproduce, or a small example

## What happens next

- I'll reply within a week.
- If it's real, I'll work on a fix and keep you updated.
- When the fix is out, I'll publish the advisory and thank you in it, unless you'd rather stay anonymous.
